name: General tools -> public page + delivery checklist sync
description: Source: General tools (internal). Publishes the public General tools page without [internal] content and keeps the Base tool checklist in the [TEMPLATE] Delivery checklist in sync. Triggered by Confluence Automation (page edited).

assignments.name: publicBanner
assignments.value: This page is updated automatically. Edits made directly on it are overwritten.

parameters.content:
## General tools sync
Source: **General tools (internal)** (2076311575), restricted. Targets: the public **General tools** page (1540030465) and sheet **Base tool checklist** in [TEMPLATE] Delivery checklist.

**Public page (top branch, runs first):** copies the internal page minus anything tagged [internal] (column headers, headings and their section, paragraphs/panels/expands starting with the tag, rows whose cell starts with the tag). Writes only when the result changed (hash in the version message). Aborts and DMs Antonio if the tag would still show or fewer than 30 tools remain. Never blocks the checklist branch.

**Checklist (bottom branch):** matching uses column I (Sync key); only columns I-J and inserted rows are written. Status, Priority, Owner etc. are never edited.

Runs on Confluence Automation "Page edited" (webhook, header x-sync-secret). Set **dryRun** / **publicDryRun** in Config to preview without writing.

parameters.text: ={{ '*General tools -> public page*\n' + ($json.alertText || ('Updating the public page failed: ' + (($json.error && ($json.error.message || JSON.stringify($json.error))) || 'unknown error'))) + '\n<' + $('Config').first().json.publicPageUrl + '|Public page>  |  <' + $('Config').first().json.pageUrl + '|Internal page>' }}
